messages:
Mara: Quick stand  compact telemetry shipping plan. Need a small, low-cost console surface that covers cost-by-route, quick trace linking, and error fingerprints. Keep infra delta tiny.

Leo: Agree. My proposal: "compact mode" = aggregated cost + light-weight trace pointers (no full span ingestion). We only store sampled full traces on demand.

Deepa: From SRE: important to have deterministic sampling and a fast on-demand fetch for full traces during incidents. Also need a rate cap so storage doesn't spike.

Carlos: UX asks: dashboard card that shows 30d cost, last-24h sparkline, and an expand-to-detail that shows top 5 routes. Minimally interactive, copy+export button.

Mara: Two customer asks: 1) small startups want per-route cost in hosted to debug runaway requests; 2) larger customers want retention controls and audit logs. We can't do both at GA.

Leo: Implementation constraint: hosted GA can support per-route & per-model cost if customers provide an attribution header (X-RW-ATTR). Dedicated/Private get server-side tenant mapping + retention UI.

Deepa: Error analytics: ship fingerprinting + sample stack snippet for top N fingerprints. That gives actionable signal without storing all exception traces.

Carlos: Also include a trace-link flow: when a user clicks a request id, console queries a /trace-fetch endpoint that returns either a sampled flamegraph or a link to raw trace in a private bucket (for dedicated).

Mara: Draft acceptance criteria: cost numbers within 2% on synthetic load, trace-link latency <300ms p95 for sampled fetch, and fingerprint grouping accuracy at least ~85% for top errors.

Leo: API sketch I'll build: `/v1/telemetry/costs?range=30d&group=route` and `/v1/telemetry/trace?req_id=...&mode=compact`. We'll require `X-RW-ATTR` optional header.

Leo: Sample header snippet for SDKs:
```
X-RW-ATTR: customer_account=acme;env=prod;feature=chat
```

Deepa: Rollout plan: start with internal + beta customers -> 2% hosted traffic for 48h -> monitor cost aggregation and error false-positive rate -> 10% -> full. Rollback triggers: cost deviation >25% or error rate >3x baseline.

Mara: Scope cuts for GA: no anomaly detection, no ad-hoc query builder, no long-term raw-trace retention for hosted. Export CSV + webhook alerting only.

Carlos: I'll ship dashboard mock and tiny copy-to-CSV action. Need Leo's minimal API by Thursday to wire interaction.

ci-bot: Telemetry feature branch created: feature/compact-telemetry. CI pipeline queued.

Leo: I will also add a small client migration note in docs about X-RW-ATTR and how attribution impacts hosted cost reports.

Deepa: SLOs to own: ingestion overhead <30ms p95, cost aggregation drift <2%, alert delivery <60s. I'll add perf tests.

Mara: Owners & dates: Leo (APIs + perf tests) EOD Thu; Carlos (UI mocks + CSV) Fri; Deepa (SLOs + runbook) Fri; Mara will coordinate beta invites & comms. Confirm here by EOD. :rocket:
